# ACE Environment Extended

ACE Environment Extended (AEE) is a physically accurate environment
simulation for Arma 3, extending ACE3. It models elevation lapse rates,
terrain microclimate, true air density, Koppen biome classification,
thermal and physiological effects, optics, mobility, environmental
conditions, maritime state, radio propagation, and atmospheric events.

The mod is standalone. It requires only `CBA_A3`. The core addons have no `ACE3`
dependency; the compat addon `compat_ace3` connects the simulation to ACE3.

Author: [lErrorl404l](https://github.com/lErrorl404l). Licence:
[GPL-2.0-or-later](https://github.com/lErrorl404l/AEE/blob/main/LICENSE) with a
PBO-distribution exception.

## Features

- Elevation lapse rates and diurnal temperature cycles.
- Terrain microclimate, including urban heat islands and water influence.
- True air density from temperature, pressure, and humidity.
- Koppen biome classification with seasonal variation.
- WBGT heat stress and altitude acclimatisation.
- FAA time-of-useful-consciousness hypoxia.
- ISO 17166 UV index with ozone absorption.
- Optics effects, including thermal crossover, mirage, and glare.
- Cn²-based atmospheric seeing.
- Vehicle and helicopter mobility, including engine derating and lift.
- Environmental effects, including foliage, scent, and fire risk.
- Rothermel fire spread.
- Stefan freeze and thaw depth.
- FAO-56 Penman-Monteith evaporation.
- Maritime state, including harmonic tidal constituents (M2/S2/K1/O1).
- WMO Beaufort sea state.
- Radio propagation from the Friis equation with ITU-R P.531 ionospheric
  absorption.
- ICAO eddy dissipation rate turbulence.
- Atmospheric events, including lightning, sandstorms, and NWS microburst
  tiers.
- Wildlife, with a biome and weather aware ambient soundscape and
  client-local animals.
- NATO APP-6(C) map symbology and topographic terrain symbols, drawn on
  the engine map layer.

## Addon structure

The project has 45 addons under `addons/`. The 39 core addons are `actions`,
`ai`, `altitude`, `ambience`, `armour`, `atmos`, `ballistics`, `blast`,
`cartography`, `clothing`, `core`, `diagnostics`, `dive`, `eye`, `flight`,
`hud`, `hydrology`, `lib`, `lighting`, `ltm`, `magnetism`, `maritime`,
`material`, `mobility`, `nightvision`, `optics`, `particles`, `persistence`,
`physiology`, `radio`, `strain`, `symbology`, `thermal`, `thermal_display`,
`vehicles`, `vision`, `weather`, `weatherfx`, and `wildlife`. The 6 compat
addons are `compat_ace3`, `compat_acm`, `compat_acre2`, `compat_kat`,
`compat_realweather`, and `compat_tfar`.

| Addon | Role |
|---|---|
| `actions` | Player actions and reports |
| `ai` | Autonomous agents, senses and disturbance |
| `altitude` | Altitude, hypoxia and G-load |
| `ambience` | Ambient soundscape and acoustics |
| `armour` | Vehicle armour and penetration |
| `atmos` | Atmosphere and weather |
| `ballistics` | Air density and ballistics |
| `blast` | Blast, craters and fragmentation |
| `cartography` | Map surface, grid and palette |
| `clothing` | Clothing insulation and equipment mass |
| `core` | Orchestrator and shared state |
| `diagnostics` | Diagnostics, consistency and state dumps |
| `dive` | Diving state |
| `eye` | Eye adaptation and vision |
| `flight` | Aircraft flight and aerodynamics |
| `hud` | HUD, rangefinder and tracker |
| `hydrology` | Runoff, erosion and river level |
| `lib` | Shared engine, geometry and maths library |
| `lighting` | Night sky, stars and world lighting |
| `ltm` | Laser target marker |
| `magnetism` | Magnetic field and compass |
| `maritime` | Sea state and tides |
| `material` | Shared material and soil properties |
| `mobility` | Vehicle and ground mobility |
| `nightvision` | Night vision and image intensification |
| `optics` | Optics and visibility |
| `particles` | Particles and visual effects |
| `persistence` | Freeze-thaw, CBRN, fire and seismic |
| `physiology` | Physiological effects |
| `radio` | Radio propagation |
| `strain` | Strain, fatigue and morale |
| `symbology` | NATO/OPFOR map symbology |
| `thermal` | Temperature and thermal effects |
| `thermal_display` | Thermal display and fusion |
| `vehicles` | Vehicle systems and engine |
| `vision` | Base grade and perception |
| `weather` | Biome, climate and dispersion |
| `weatherfx` | Weather visual effects |
| `wildlife` | Wildlife ecology and behaviour |
| `compat_ace3` | ACE3 integration |
| `compat_acm` | ACM integration |
| `compat_acre2` | ACRE2 integration |
| `compat_kat` | KAT integration |
| `compat_realweather` | Real-weather file integration |
| `compat_tfar` | TFAR integration |

Build PBO names are `aee_<component>`. For example, the core addon builds to
`aee_core.pbo`.
